headers.x-trace-id: optional client trace identifier; server preserves it when present
headers.x-session-id: optional session identifier; defaults to default

cancellation.disconnectRule: A client disconnect closes the observed stream without a semantic terminal; the runtime persists cancellation independently.

replacement.acceptedState: The previous trace remains status=superseded with replacement.status=accepted and points to the replacement trace.
replacement.startupFailureState: Before an accepting event, startup failure restores the exact runtime-session bytes and the previous trace, while the failed replacement trace remains auditable.

payload.traceConsistency: When present, traceId/sessionId equal the accepted request identifiers. Legacy snake_case aliases are accepted for tool and session fields.

ordering.phaseRule: A phase may emit running heartbeats before one non-running completion/warning packet. task_planning may overlap model execution; first occurrence order is used for deterministic fixtures.
ordering.heartbeatRule: A heartbeat packet is TurnPhase with heartbeat=true, status=running, and a non-negative elapsedMs; it never terminates a phase.
ordering.toolRule: Each ToolStart has one later ToolDone with the same tool name and call id unless a cancellation fixture explicitly lists that tool in expected.interruptedToolSequence. Read-only fixtures must not emit a mutating tool. A ToolDone error is allowed only when expected.toolErrorSequence explicitly lists that tool.
ordering.fixtureEventRule: expected.requiredEventSequence freezes the exact relative order and multiplicity of the named events; expected.forbiddenEvents rejects any occurrence in either implementation.
ordering.providerRule: ProviderStream, ModelCompleted, UsageUpdate, TextChunk and ReasoningPlan are model/runtime events and must occur after AgentStarted when present.

errorBoundary.httpErrors: Malformed requests and agent_busy remain HTTP error envelopes and do not become a successful SSE stream.
errorBoundary.streamErrors: After a 200 response, execution failures are AgentError payloads followed by exactly one done transport event; provider HTTP status and stage remain observable.
errorBoundary.runtimeStartRule: AgentStarted is emitted only after the bridge process starts and accepts its request; a bridge startup failure emits TurnContract, AgentError and done without AgentStarted.

replay.activation: Explicit STORYDEX_AGENT_PROVIDER_REPLAY_FIXTURE only; missing or mismatched fixtures fail closed.
replay.liveEvidence: Replay observations are labelled providerMode=replay and must never be reported as live provider success.
